annotations.title: Tell me when a business is free

description: Ask Speedi to email someone when a particular business sets its light to green, including after a cancellation. Use only when the person asks to be told later about a specific business. Needs the provider id from find_available_providers and an email address the person has given in this conversation for this purpose; do not guess or reuse one. Every email has a one-click unsubscribe. Saves a notification request; does not contact the business.

email.description: The address the person gave for this notification.

providerId.description: The provider's id, exactly as find_available_providers returned it.

name: notify_me_when_free
